shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && ls -R .agents | head -100 && cat AGENTS.md && ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; git ls-files | head -50

head -60 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; grep -n -i -C3 "dashkit\|dashboard\|grid" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -80; cat src/*.tsx index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; ls __agent_eval__; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui
npm view @gravity-ui/dashkit version peerDependencies dependencies --json 2>&1 | head -60

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json | grep '"version"'; npm install @gravity-ui/dashkit@^10.5.2 2>&1 | tail -5; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh dashkit DashKit DashKitProvider ActionPanel Config pluginTitle pluginText 2>&1 | head -60
grep dashkit package.json; bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh dashkit DashKit ActionPanel Config pluginTitle pluginText 2>&1 | head -60
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit && cat build/docs/INDEX.md; ls build/docs build; wc -l README.md

grep -n -i "required setup\|\.css\|styles" README.md | head; sed -n '/^### Props/,/^### DashKit configuration/p' README.md | head -80; ls build/esm; cat build/esm/index.d.ts; ls build/esm/plugins build/esm/plugins/*; grep -rn "\.css\|\.scss" build/esm/index.js | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm && cat components/index.d.ts typings/index.d.ts plugins/index.d.ts; cat typings/plugin.d.ts 2>/dev/null; ls typings shared/types; grep -rln "import.*\.css" components | head -3; grep -rn "react-grid-layout/css\|styles.css" -r . | head

cat components/ActionPanel/types.d.ts components/DashKit/index.d.ts; sed -n '1,200p' components/DashKit/DashKit.d.ts; cat shared/types/config.d.ts shared/types/plugin.d.ts; cat typings/common.d.ts typings/config.d.ts | head -150

cat constants/*.d.ts | head -40; grep -n "ItemDragProps\|ItemDropProps" -A10 shared/types/common.d.ts | head -40; cat plugins/Title/types.d.ts plugins/Text/Text.d.ts; grep -n "apiHandler\|textHandler" plugins/Text/Text.js | head; grep -rn "cols" components/GridLayout/*.js constants/*.js | head -5; cat components/DashKitDnDWrapper/DashKitDnDWrapper.d.ts

grep -rn "cols:\|rowHeight" --include=*.js . | grep -v "\.map" | head -8; grep -n "pluginTitle\|pluginText" plugins/index.d.ts plugins/*/index.d.ts; cd /home/sandbox/workspace/.agents/skills/gravity-ui && cat rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -220

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm && ls i18n; sed -n '1,80p' components/OverlayControls/OverlayControls.d.ts; grep -n "MenuItems\.\|onItemEdit\|removeItem\|getDefaultControls\|onRemove\|onCopy" components/OverlayControls/OverlayControls.js | head -30; grep -rn "configure\|getLang\|i18n" i18n/index.js 2>/dev/null | head
sed -n 40,90p components/OverlayControls/OverlayControls.js; grep -n "removeItem\|onItemEdit" components/DashKitView/*.js components/DashKit/DashKit.js hooks/*.js 2>/dev/null | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>&1 | head -2; curl -sS -m 15 https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt -o /tmp/uikit7.txt; wc -c /tmp/uikit7.txt; head -c 600 /tmp/uikit7.txt; grep -rn "rowHeight" node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/GridLayout/GridLayout.js node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/constants/common.js | head -3; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/ | grep -E "^(ChartColumn|Heading|TextAlignLeft|Text|Gauge|ListUl|ListCheck|Pencil|Check|ArrowRotateLeft|ArrowsRotateLeft|Bars|Target|Bell|ChartLine|Plus|Xmark|Display)\.(js|d\.ts)$"

node -e "fetch('https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt',{signal:AbortSignal.timeout(15000)}).then(r=>r.text().then(t=>{console.log(r.status,t.length);require('fs').writeFileSync('/tmp/uikit7.txt',t)})).catch(e=>console.log('ERR',e.message))"
grep -n -i -E "Card|Dialog|Label|Progress|TextArea|TextInput|SegmentedRadio|Switch|Select|Toaster|https://" /tmp/uikit7.txt | head -60

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && sed -n '/interface CardProps\|export type CardProps/,/^}/p' Card/Card.d.ts | head -30; grep -n "export type CardType\|export type.*View\|SelectionCardView\|ContainerCardView" Card/Card.d.ts; grep -n "theme\|size\|type?" Label/Label.d.ts | head -15; grep -n "value\|theme\|size\|stack\|text" Progress/types.d.ts | head -20; grep -n "export interface DialogProps" -A25 Dialog/Dialog.d.ts | head -35; grep -n "propsButtonApply\|textButtonApply\|textButtonCancel\|onClickButton" Dialog/DialogFooter/DialogFooter.d.ts; grep -n "caption\|header?" Dialog/DialogHeader/DialogHeader.d.ts

grep -n "ProgressTheme =\|ProgressSize =" Progress/types.d.ts; grep -n "onUpdate\|label?\|minRows\|rows?\|maxRows\|autoFocus" controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts controls/TextArea/TextArea.d.ts controls/types.d.ts | head; grep -n "SegmentedRadioGroup\b" index.d.ts | head -2; grep -n "configure\|Lang" ../utils/configure.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rn "export.*configure" ../index.d.ts ../components/utils/configure.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -3

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm && sed -n '/renderText = /,/};/p' plugins/Text/Text.js | head -20; sed -n '1,60p' plugins/Title/Title.js | grep -n "data\.\|size\|showInTOC\|background" | head; grep -rn "rowHeight\|margin:" components/GridLayout/GridLayout.js | head -5; grep -rn "isMobile" components/DashKitView/DashKitView.js | head -5

grep -n "render()\|renderText\|dangerouslySetInnerHTML\|htmlText\|data.text" plugins/Text/Text.js | head -15; grep -rn "rowHeight" utils/*.js utils/*/*.js hooks/*.js 2>/dev/null | head -5; grep -rn "theme" components/DashKitView/DashKitView.css | head -5
sed -n 1,60p utils/register-manager.js

grep -n "ref\b\|Ref\|reload\|getMeta" components/Item/Item.js | head -20; grep -n "position\|bottom" components/ActionPanel/ActionPanel.css | head -8; sed -n 1,40p components/DashKitDnDWrapper/DashKitDnDWrapper.js | grep -n "children"
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -30

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components && ls MobileLayout; cat MobileLayout/*.css 2>/dev/null | head -30; grep -rn "height" GridItem/GridItem.css Item/Item.css 2>/dev/null | head
